threats.title: Onboard Clock Subsystem Bias Injection
threats.mechanism: Injecting subtle clock bias via disciplined oscillator interference to generate range bias eps across observables.

threats.title: Integrity Monitoring Evasion
threats.mechanism: Crafting stealthy bias steps that remain inside the detection threshold gap during weak HDOP passes.

threats.title: Cross-Check Module Spoofing Evasion
threats.mechanism: Simultaneously spoofing independent LEO-MLAT position and broadcast ADS-B to evade the cross-check integrity indicator.

threats.title: Ephemeris and Clock Database Corruption
threats.mechanism: Tampering with stored satellite positions, velocities, or clock states introduces systematic localisation errors.

threats.title: PTP Time-Transfer Message Injection
threats.mechanism: Injecting forged PTP time-transfer messages between satellites to subtly shift the internal time reference.

threats.title: GNSS Service Spoofing and Timing Disruption
threats.mechanism: An RF emitter transmits spoofed GNSS signals to corrupt the onboard position and time reference.

threats.title: Satellite Bus Flight Software Compromise
threats.mechanism: Malicious command execution alters flight software behaviour, compromising platform and payload stability.

threats.title: Malicious Telecommand and Firmware Injection
threats.mechanism: Injecting malicious update packages or unauthorized telecommands via compromised uplink channels.

threats.title: Central Processing Platform Privilege Escalation
threats.mechanism: Exploiting virtualization or OS vulnerabilities on Central Processing Station servers to gain administrative control.

threats.title: Orbit Determination Ephemeris Poisoning
threats.mechanism: Injecting false satellite orbit parameters into the ephemeris product generation pipeline.

threats.title: Key-Management Credential Disclosure
threats.mechanism: Unauthorized access to the key-management system compromises cryptographic credentials for links and telecommands.

threats.title: Configuration and Software Update Tampering
threats.mechanism: Altering filter parameters, integrity thresholds, or firmware baselines stored in the configuration management system.

threats.title: ATM Controller Working Position Deception
threats.mechanism: Delivering deceptive aircraft tracks with nominal integrity annotations directly to controller working positions.

threats.title: Insider Threat and Credential Abuse
threats.mechanism: Compromised operator personnel or malicious suppliers abuse authorized access to alter critical L3/L4 configurations.

threats.title: Operations Centre Network Intrusion
threats.mechanism: Compromising workstations and management networks in the mission-operations centre to gain access to governance assets.

threats.title: ADS-B Transponder Position Fabrication
threats.mechanism: An attacker transmits unauthenticated 1090ES messages to fabricate non-existent aircraft tracks or alter reported position.

threats.title: Payload Processor Firmware Tampering
threats.mechanism: Exploitation of satellite payload interfaces modifies extraction firmware, skewing TOA or AOA measurements.

threats.title: Ground Station Antenna Jamming
threats.mechanism: RF jamming or interference directed at ground-station antennas disrupts downlink reception and telecommand links.

threats.title: Observable Report Tampering in Transit
threats.mechanism: Unauthenticated observable reports are intercepted and modified during inter-satellite relay or downlink transmission.

threats.title: Inter-Satellite Link Traffic Disruption
threats.mechanism: Denial of service or RF interference targets crosslinks, cutting off satellite report relay paths.

threats.title: Measurement Association Confusion
threats.mechanism: Crafted timing and position spoofing causes the association module to misgroup receptions across satellites.

threats.title: Localisation Solver Track Manipulation
threats.mechanism: Manipulating inputs or solver states in the EKF/IMM tracker to displace computed aircraft positions.

threats.title: ASTERIX Report Encoder Corruption
threats.mechanism: Tampering with encoding logic to alter CAT020/021 integrity annotations or suppress target reports sent to ATM.

threats.title: Time-Reference Policy Modification
threats.mechanism: Modifying the synchronization policy or PTP conformance thresholds to weaken onboard clock discipline.

threats.title: Phased-Array Antenna Angle Manipulation
threats.mechanism: An RF-local emitter introduces multi-path or signal interference to degrade angle of arrival measurements.

threats.title: Downlink and Backhaul Data Interception
threats.mechanism: Eavesdropping on unencrypted or weakly protected downlinks and ground backhaul networks to disclose surveillance data.

threats.title: Surveillance Data Feed Interception
threats.mechanism: Eavesdropping or tampering with the surveillance data feed transmitted from the processing station to ATM.

architecture_weaknesses: Assumption W4 notes observable reports carry no message authentication, leaving L2 highly vulnerable to unauthenticated tampering and replay attacks.
The reliance on unauthenticated ADS-B self-reports creates a fundamental vulnerability exploitable during cross-checks.
Weak HDOP passes create a persistent stealth window where bias steps breach requirements without triggering L3 integrity monitors.
Inter-satellite links lack robust cryptographic protection specified in the architecture, enabling relay disruption and traffic redirection.
PTP time-transfer messages lack authentication, permitting subtle clock bias injection that bypasses onboard L1 checks.
Centralized processing platform hosting represents a single point of failure and high-value target for lateral movement from L4 networks.
overall: The SATERA LEO-MLAT-B threat model highlights critical risks stemming from unauthenticated ADS-B emissions, clock bias injection vectors, and weak geometric passes. Mitigating these threats requires end-to-end cryptographic authentication across all communication layers, enhanced integrity monitoring during high-HDOP states, and rigorous key management to prevent sophisticated state-level disruption.
